# Romolo's Cannoli

> Authentic Sicilian cannoli, dolci, and gelato handcrafted in San Mateo, California since 1968. Three generations, one family recipe.

Romolo's Cannoli is a third-generation, family-owned Sicilian bakery and gelato shop in San Mateo, California. We hand-fill every cannoli to order with fresh ricotta cream and serve a rotating daily menu of traditional Italian pastries and house-made gelato. Founded in 1968, Romolo's has been recognized locally as one of the Bay Area's best cannoli destinations.

## About
- [Heritage](https://romoloscannoli.com/#heritage): Family history since 1968, three generations of cannoli-making
- [Our Process](https://romoloscannoli.com/#process): How each cannoli is made by hand

## Menu & Ordering
- [Menu](https://romoloscannoli.com/#menu): Cannoli, Italian pastries (dolci), and house-made gelato — selection rotates daily based on what's freshly made
- [Order Online](https://romoloscannoli.com/#menu): Place a pickup order through the on-site ordering flow powered by Square

- Service area: San Mateo, Hillsdale, Foster City, Burlingame, and the greater San Mateo County / Peninsula
